class.name: LinearVelocityLayeredMove
class.brief_description: A layered move that proposes a constant velocity.
class.description: A dash, a knockback, a conveyor, a gust. The one concrete [LayeredMove] that ships, because it is the shape most of them are - anything else is a [Resource] subclass away, in C++ or in GDScript.

members.member: Fades the contribution to nothing across [member LayeredMove.duration], so a knockback eases off instead of stopping like a wall. Ignored when the duration is not positive, because there is nothing to fade across.
The velocity to propose, in metres per second.
